text: Are you currently experiencing severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding?
No, he is not having chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding. He is awake and talking with no head strike or blackout.
Can you tell us what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale of 0 to 10?
My father fell down four steps at home about an hour ago and landed on his right hip. His pain is currently 7 out of 10.

writes: fell down four steps at home and landed on his right hip

text: Are his fingers or toes numb, cold, pale, blue, or unable to move, and does the cast feel too tight?
I don't know about his fingers or toes or the cast because he wasn't wearing one. He is awake and talking right now.
Do you know if he takes any regular medications?
Yes, he takes a small pill to thin his blood called warfarin and another blood pressure pill I cannot name. He also has conditions including irregular heartbeat and high blood pressure.

writes: blood pressure pill I cannot name

text: Do you have any allergies to medicines, are you pregnant or recently postpartum, or do you have any conditions affecting your immune system?
I am allergic to penicillin because it causes a rash. I am not pregnant and do not have any conditions affecting my immune system.
Do you have any fever, rash, overseas travel in the last two weeks, or contact with anyone who is infectious?
No, there is no fever, rash, recent overseas travel, or contact with anyone who is infectious.
Could you please tell me when you last ate or drank, along with your name and date of birth for our hospital records?
My father last had porridge at 1pm. His name is Mr. Tan Ah Kow and his date of birth is January 2, 1939.
